beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Egregopathy asks how ordinary participants can sustain an institution that behaves without remorse.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its proposed concept concerns organizational patterns, rather than a psychiatric diagnosis of groups.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book traces boundaries that separate harmful consequences from authority and moral language.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its distinctive challenge is that replacing a villain may leave the mechanism intact.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The argument also turns its own persuasive method into an object of criticism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An office can change occupants while preserving the incentives that sustain harmful behavior.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Decision-makers receive selected information, while affected outsiders carry consequences they cannot readily contest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Moral statements may become easier for the institution to produce than costly correction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book treats that pattern as a design question, not proof that every member lacks conscience.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This shifts the investigation from identifying monsters toward examining boundaries, feedback, and responsibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Historical and contemporary cases build the argument across several kinds of organized power.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The final critical turn examines whether the invented category compresses too much.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An institution has no clinical mind that can simply receive an individual psychiatric diagnosis.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also challenges its own selection of evidence and persuasive arrangement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That self-examination is part of its distinctive reading experience, rather than a disposable disclaimer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with The Crime With No Criminal and follow the separation of authority from harm.
